title: Answer: consciousness is observed through reports in humans and through architecture in AI

statements.text: The view takes no position on measurement in physics. In humans the science of consciousness relies on reports, contrasting conditions in which subjects report seeing a stimulus with those in which they do not. In AI, where behavior can be trained to mimic humans, it is observed by examining which computations a system performs.

sources.quote: This method relies on the assumption that subjects’ reports are a good guide to their conscious experiences.
